$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for storefront values that are a closed set.
Consumed by src/lib/storefrontEnums.js (Vite JSON import) and by
backend/main.py (json.load at import time). Do NOT hand-copy these lists
into a component, a validator, or a prompt — read them from here.
A value that is not in one of these lists cannot be rendered by
Storefront.jsx, so the backend must refuse to persist it.
